test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A lady professes to sell sugar at 20% profit on the cost price and using a weight which is 30% less than the actual measure. What is her gain percentage?
solution:
**Given Data:**

Lady sells sugar at 20% profit and,

Uses a weight 30% less than the actual measure.

**Formula Used:**

Actual Profit% = [(P + W) / (1 - W)] × 100

Profit% = P (in decimal)

Less weight% = W (in decimal)

**Solution:**

20% = 0.2 & 30% = 0.3

Actual Profit% = [(P + W) / (1 - W)] × 100

⇒ Actual Profit% = [(0.2 + 0.3)/(1 - 0.3)] × 100

⇒ Actual Profit% = (0.5/0.7) × 100

⇒ Actual Profit% = 500/7

⇒ Total gain% = 71(3)/(7)\%

**Therefore, her gain percentage is 71(3)/(7)\%.**
